sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:08 – 17:00)
items: Team 1 briefing complete; area coverage confirmed, equipment checked. Commencing patrols from HQ.
Patrol cycle (09:08–12:00); welfare checks completed on businesses and stores across:

Response from Team 1 regarding a shoplifter who had returned to a store they previously stole from. Collected a physical photo of the POI, then caught the shoplifter a few stores down, returned the stolen items, and issued a 2-year trespass notice at the store manager's request — breach will lead to charges and arrest (photo on file).
Arrived at Headquarters for route change with Team 1.
Route change complete; heading back downstairs to do reports.
Patrol cycle (12:05–16:30), with welfare checks on upper and lower Queen Street businesses, through:

Response from Team 1 regarding another shoplifter who had returned to a store (Hallensteins, Queen St) they previously stole from. Responded quickly but the POI fled on arrival; staff had no footage, photos, or description. Standing by outside maintaining visible presence.
Heading back to Headquarters for a 30-minute break and to complete Auror reports.
Team 2 shift completed; equipment accounted for and handed over. Team 2 standing down.
